newsitem.title: UK: United News & Media sets 180 mln stg bond.
newsitem.headline: United News & Media sets 180 mln stg bond.

text.p: United News & Media Plc has launched a 180 million stg subordinated convertible bond.
The issuer has granted the lead manager an over-allotment option of up to a further 23 million stg.
The indicated coupon range is 6.125 to 6.375 percent payable semi-annually on June 3 and December 3.

Conversion premium is 14 to 18 percent. There is a call option at par from December 17, 2001. There are fees of 2.5 percent of which 1.0 percent is combined management and underwriting and 1.5 percent is selling commission.
There will be a lead managers's praecipium of 0.25 percent. Pay date is December 3.
The bonds are listed in London and have denominations of 5,000 and 50,000. English law applies.
The lead manager is Dresdner Kleinwort Benson.
